test_case.test_name: Parameterized CoralGEMM all-GPU peak system-PSU power validation
test_case.purpose: Drive every approved GPU with the source-defined CoralGEMM workload and measure the true maximum system PSU output from synchronized BMC telemetry, including ramp transients, against approved limits.
required_package: Pinned CoralGEMM binary/source revision, checksum and GPU/driver compatibility
Exact source command `./gemm R_64F R_64F R_64F R_64F OP_N OP_T 8640 8640 8640 8640 8640 8640 36 1200`
Stable GPU UUID/BDF map and expected all-GPU participation
Authoritative BMC PSU output sensor IDs/units/update cadence/timebase and sampling method
Approved maximum/tolerance, PSU/cooling headroom, timeout/abort and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: After artifact, topology, BMC sensor, limit and load approval, start timestamped BMC polling of every authoritative PSU output sensor before workload launch, run the exact CoralGEMM command, continue through ramp and steady state, and compute the maximum system PSU value with the approved aggregation. Retain full workload and telemetry; do not substitute local `sensors` or AMD-SMI inventory.
test_case.expected_result: All intended GPUs enter the defined high-stress state, synchronized BMC PSU telemetry captures the initial transient and maximum within the approved limit/tolerance, and no GPU, PSU, thermal, PCIe/xGMI, kernel or BMC fault occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified BMC PSU sensors/timebase, pre-ramp sampling, all-GPU workload evidence and comparison to an approved maximum/tolerance. Local rail readings, inventory output or absent limits cannot pass.
safety_gate: All-GPU high power requires explicit approval, PSU/cooling capacity and workload isolation.
Verify BMC sensor identity/units/cadence before load and begin polling before ramp.
Pin GPUs by UUID/BDF and track the exact workload process.
Abort on PSU/thermal limit, XID/ECC/link error, sensor loss, hang or lost OOB; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Distinct Source Key/Variant identities for peak power and inventory
CoralGEMM checksum/command, GPU map and full workload log
BMC PSU sensor inventory with units/cadence/timebase
Timestamped pre-ramp/ramp/steady telemetry and computed maximum
Approved limit/tolerance comparison, GPU/thermal/PSU/kernel/BMC health and return-to-idle
test_case.recovery: Stop the tracked workload on abort, preserve raw PSU and GPU logs, verify PSU/GPU/thermal state returns to idle and use approved OOB/service recovery only if necessary. Do not rerun automatically.
